dedupe_keys.name: borehole orientation data for stimtec and stimtec x

description: Victoria Jimenez Martinez and Jörg Renner publish the STIMTEC and STIMTEC-X borehole investigation collection from the Reiche Zeche research mine in Freiberg, Germany. The central orientation deposit supplies depth, tilt, azimuth and coordinates for seventeen of nineteen boreholes drilled during 2018–2020. Explicitly linked deposits add optical and acoustic televiewer, sonic and caliper logs, core photographs, impression-packer foils, characteristic pressures and fracture orientations, and German daily activity reports. Each checked component is freely available under CC BY 4.0. The collection can constrain geometry and fractured-rock properties in hydraulic-stimulation or geothermal simulations. READMEs define instrument and orientation conventions. Packer images require orientation corrections, and core-photo lengths can differ from independently measured boreholes. Coordinate reference and measurement uncertainty need further checks. Related files are grouped as one study family, not separate catalogue additions. No existing catalogue record explicitly covers this family. Numerical logs, photographs and report values were not downloaded or interpreted.
